scientific_scope: Success means the selected commands completed their declared reproduction levels. The retained v1.4 scientific implementation provides its sufficient-statistic/prediction replay; new compact modules reconstruct comparisons, uncertainty summaries and figures from archived intermediate quantities. Raw-data preprocessing and native estimator refitting are not part of the default command. Archival-only and missing-input states remain explicit.

exit_codes.0: All selected commands completed with no explicitly partial native status. Consult declared scope and native reports for reproduction level.
exit_codes.1: Setup, integrity, execution, invalid/missing receipt or numerical verification failure.
exit_codes.2: Partial coverage, missing inputs, stored-result-only task, timeout or interruption.

modules.name: fixed_tasks
modules.scope: Existing v1.4 four-donor ranking/depth, D4 supplement and Stim, independent RNA, interactions and external-baseline replay. Native model fits and raw-cell preprocessing are not rerun.

modules.name: early_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved-query score/block to original statistical summary replay
modules.scope: Recomputes the supplied four-source, factorial and early-study statistics from retained intermediate scores and bootstrap definitions. Original raw inputs, effects, reliability weights and candidate rankings are not reconstructed; archival-only items retain their identity.

modules.name: corrected_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved intermediate quantities to corrected-evidence statistical comparisons
modules.scope: Corrected guide and RNA evidence summary replay from retained intermediate arrays; the native report specifies recomputed contrasts and omitted upstream stages.

modules.name: r20_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Saved per-query scores to original within-screen and independent-RNA statistics
modules.scope: Five within-screen and two external-reference input groups per donor; original block definitions and bootstrap statistics. Does not reconstruct moments, predictions or raw CSR aggregation.

modules.name: paper_analysis
modules.reproduction_level: Existing analysis replay and frozen-source figure regeneration
modules.scope: S3 post hoc analysis, biology strata, fixed-panel transfer, TRADE sensitivity, application and figures. Figure regeneration is identified separately from recomputing source experiments.

modules.name: il2_intermediates
modules.reproduction_level: Fixed guide/MAGeCK readout scores to original primary and secondary comparisons
modules.scope: All 561 candidates and ten fixed top-25 lists; reconstruct target medians, original 20,000 paired guide/control draws, intervals and MAGeCK support comparisons. Eligibility remains fixed and no raw counts or model fitting are used.

modules.name: sensitivity_replay
modules.reproduction_level: Saved-draw summary and fixed-coefficient numerical reconstruction
modules.scope: Four archived sensitivity draw groups and Mixscale fixed-coefficient scores/intervals; preserves the existing definitions and does not refit coefficients.

modules.name: software
modules.reproduction_level: Optional software tests and tutorial smoke tests
modules.scope: Requires a separate environment with modules/paper_analysis/software[test] installed. This verifies the software interface; it does not add biological validation.
